messages:
Harpreet: Quick follow-up from today's PM for PM-2999 (eviction cascade during steady traffic). Need owners + firm ETAs for four action items: 1) short-term throttle/rollback, 2) eviction dashboard + alerts, 3) regression harness + CI gate, 4) add recurring-pattern notes to playbook. Please ack and update Jiras by EOD tomorrow.

Noah: Ack. I can take short-term throttle and rollback checklist. ETA: 48-72h. R=Noah, A=Harpreet, C=Ivy.

Ivy: I'll own dashboard + alert panels and the metric export. R=Ivy, A=Harpreet, C=QA Bot. ETA: 7 days. Will add eviction-rate, kv-hit-rate, and p99 tail latency panels.

QA Bot: I'll own regression harness and CI gating. R=QA Bot, A=Harpreet, C=Ivy. ETA: PR with tests in 10 days. Gating rule proposal: staging must pass deterministic repro for 24h.

Harpreet: Created PM-2999 and new issues: INF-4210 (throttle + rollback), INF-4211 (dashboard + alerts), INF-4212 (regression harness + gating), INF-4213 (playbook: recurring-pattern).

Jira Bot: Created INF-4210, INF-4211, INF-4212, INF-4213 and linked to PM-2999.

Noah: INF-4210 assigned to Noah. I'll attach a quick mitigation PR and rollback steps. Will also note which configs to revert if we see eviction rate spike.

Ivy: INF-4211 assigned to Ivy. I'll add panels and an alert: eviction-rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m triggers paging. Also will add a short dashboard doc.

QA Bot: INF-4212 assigned to QA Bot. I'll add deterministic repro scripts and require staging gating for 24h before merges. Acceptance: repro runs reliably in CI and gate blocks bad changes.

Harpreet: Proposed RACI summary in case anyone wants tweaks: 1) Throttle = R/Noah A/Harpreet C/Ivy I/QA Bot; 2) Dashboard = R/Ivy A/Harpreet C/Noah I/QA Bot; 3) Regression = R/QA Bot A/Harpreet C/Ivy I/Noah; 4) Playbook = R/Harpreet A/Product C/Noah I/Team.

Noah: Can we add a ticket-aging automation to force check-ins? Too many action items go quiet. Draft below.

Harpreet: Please do. Good idea. Add it to PM template.

Noah: Draft Jira automation snippet:
```
when: issue created or updated
if: status not in (Done, Cancelled) and days since created >= 4
then: add comment "Owner check-in required: update ETA or flag blocker"; set label "needs-owner-review"; notify #postmortems
```

Ivy: +1. Also suggest tagging PM-2999 with label "recurring-pattern" since we've seen similar spikes 3x in the last 2 months. Will add a short note in INF-4213.

QA Bot: I'll add a regression that simulates repeated small bursts to catch pattern regressions.

Harpreet: Hand-off plan for the remediation window: week1 primary = Noah (mitigations), week2 primary = Ivy (dashboards + validation), week3 primary = QA Bot (regressions + gating). Harpreet will be backup and own final acceptance.

Noah: Will update INF-4210 with owner, ETA, short acceptance criteria, and any blockers by EOD tomorrow.

Ivy: Will update INF-4211 and INF-4213 likewise.

QA Bot: Will post INF-4212 repro link and acceptance checklist when the PR is open.

Harpreet: Thanks team. If anyone needs reassignment, flag in the ticket and ping me. We'll reconvene in 48h if blockers remain. :white_check_mark:
